---
title: "Movie Analysis"
author: "GitHub Copilot"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: print-movies

glimpse(movies)
names(movies)
```

```{r}
#| label: missing-values

movies |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x))))
```

```{r}
#| label: top-box-office

movies |>
  filter(!is.na(boxOffice)) |>
  select(title, boxOffice) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
#| label: genre-split
#| cache: true

movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ")
```

```{r}
#| label: genre-counts

movies_clean |>
  count(genre, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: mean-scores

movies |>
  summarise(
    mean_audience_score = mean(audienceScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tomato_meter = mean(tomatoMeter, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: tomato-meter-histogram

movies |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "tomato", color = "black") +
    labs(
      x = "Tomatometer Score",
      y = "Count",
      title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores"
    )
```

```{r}
#| label: movie-gap

gap_by_genre <- movies |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore) |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ") |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    movie_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(movie_count >= 50) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

gap_by_genre
```

```{r}
#| label: gap-summary

movies |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_gap = median(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_gap = sd(gap, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: gap-by-genre

movies_summary <- movies |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore) |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ") |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    movie_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(movie_count >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

movies_summary
```

```{r}
#| label: genre-gap-chart

movies_summary |>
  mutate(genre = fct_reorder(genre, mean_gap)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = genre, y = mean_gap)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Audience-Critic Gap by Genre",
    subtitle = "Positive values favor the audience; negative values favor the critic",
    x = "Genre",
    y = "Average Gap"
  )
```

This is a simple Quarto document for the movie analysis tutorial.
